transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I'm here because I've been feeling persistently depressed and sad for a very long time now. It has been going on constantly for about two and a half years, and I just can't seem to shake this low mood.
During these past two and a half years, have there been any periods of at least two months where you felt completely back to your normal self, or has your mood been low almost every single day?

No, I haven't had any periods where I felt back to normal at all. My mood has been low almost every single day for the entire two years and five months. I definitely haven't experienced a break of two months or more where I felt like my old self.

latest_inference.note: The patient reports a constant low mood lasting two and a half years without any symptom-free intervals of two months or more. This clinical presentation meets the duration and continuity criteria for Persistent Depressive Disorder (Dysthymia), making it a more specific fit than Major Depressive Disorder alone.
